points.title: 童年时光
points.description: 1871年7月10日，马塞尔·普鲁斯特出生于巴黎一个富裕的资产阶级家庭。他的父亲阿德里安·普鲁斯特是著名的医生和流行病学家，母亲让娜·韦伊是犹太裔银行家的女儿。普鲁斯特自幼体弱多病，患有哮喘，这使他大部分时间在家中度过，培养了丰富的内心世界和敏锐的观察力。这段时期，他接触了文学和艺术，尤其是母亲和祖母讲述的故事，这些经历后来成为他创作的重要素材。
points.descriptionEn: Marcel Proust was born on July 10, 1871, in Paris to a wealthy bourgeois family. His father, Adrien Proust, was a renowned physician and epidemiologist, while his mother, Jeanne Weil, came from a Jewish banking family. Proust suffered from asthma throughout his childhood, which kept him mostly indoors and fostered a rich inner world and keen observation. During this period, he was exposed to literature and art, particularly through stories told by his mother and grandmother, experiences that later became important sources for his writing.

points.title: 求学时期
points.description: 1882年，普鲁斯特进入孔多塞中学(Lycée Condorcet)学习。尽管体弱多病，他在学业上表现出色，尤其对文学和哲学有浓厚兴趣。在此期间，他结识了未来的作家雅克·比松(Jacques Bizet)和费尔南德·格雷尼耶(Fernand Gregh)，并与他们共同创办了文学杂志《丁香花》(Le Banquet)。普鲁斯特开始发表作品，包括诗歌和评论文章，并受到当时著名作家如保罗·布尔热的赏识。这段时期奠定了他深厚的文学素养和广泛的社交圈。
points.descriptionEn: In 1882, Proust entered the Lycée Condorcet where he excelled academically despite his poor health, showing particular interest in literature and philosophy. During this time, he befriended future writers Jacques Bizet and Fernand Gregh, with whom he co-founded the literary magazine Le Banquet. Proust began publishing his own works, including poetry and critical essays, and gained recognition from established writers like Paul Bourget. This period established his profound literary foundation and broad social connections.

points.title: 社交与创作初期
points.description: 1890年代，普鲁斯特活跃于巴黎的文学沙龙和社交圈，结识了当时许多文化名流，如安娜·德·诺阿耶(Anna de Noailles)、斯特拉·达德曼(Stella Daudet)和作曲家圣-桑(Saint-Saëns)。他开始创作小说《让·桑特伊》(Jean Santeuil)，但未完成。1895年，他应征入伍，但因健康问题很快退役。1896年，他出版了第一部作品《欢乐与时光》(Les Plaisirs et les Jours)，这是一部带有自传色彩的作品集，插图由他的同学画家马蒂斯创作。这一时期，普鲁斯特的哮喘症状加重，使他更加关注内心世界和记忆的运作方式。
points.descriptionEn: During the 1890s, Proust was active in Parisian literary salons and social circles, befriending many cultural luminaries including Anna de Noailles, Stella Daudet, and composer Saint-Saëns. He began working on his novel Jean Santeuil, which remained unfinished. In 1895, he served briefly in the military but was discharged due to health issues. In 1896, he published his first book, Les Plaisirs et les Jours, a semi-autobiographical collection illustrated by his classmate Henri Matisse. During this period, Proust's asthma worsened, leading him to focus more on his inner world and the workings of memory.

points.title: 《追忆似水年华》创作
points.description: 1900年后，普鲁斯特开始构思他最著名的作品《追忆似水年华》(À la recherche du temps perdu)。1905年，他的母亲去世，这对普鲁斯特打击巨大，但也使他更加专注于写作。1907年，他开始撰写这部鸿篇巨著，并在巴黎的公寓和诺曼底的海滨小镇卡堡之间往返。卡堡的海滨旅馆成为他创作的重要场所，他经常在房间里写作到深夜。1909年，他完成了小说的第一部分《在斯万家那边》(Du côté de chez Swann)，但出版商拒绝接受。1912年，他自费出版了这部作品，但反响平平。这一时期，普鲁斯特的健康状况持续恶化，他逐渐将自己封闭在隔音的房间里，几乎与外界隔绝，全身心投入到创作中。
points.descriptionEn: After 1900, Proust began conceptualizing his most famous work, À la recherche du temps perdu (In Search of Lost Time). The death of his mother in 1905 was a profound blow, but it also led him to focus more intensely on his writing. In 1907, he started working on this monumental novel, dividing his time between his Paris apartment and the Normandy seaside town of Cabourg. The Grand Hôtel in Cabourg became an important writing place, where he often worked late into the night. In 1909, he completed the first part, Du côté de chez Swann, but publishers rejected it. In 1912, he self-published the work to little initial acclaim. During this period, Proust's health continued to deteriorate, and he gradually isolated himself in a soundproofed room, dedicating himself completely to his writing.

points.title: 晚年与作品出版
points.description: 1913年，《在斯万家那边》终于由格拉夫出版社出版，并获得了评论家雷翁·都德(Léon Daudet)的赞赏。第一次世界大战爆发后，普鲁斯特因健康原因免于服役，继续在巴黎的公寓里写作。1919年，《盖尔芒特家那边》(Le Côté de Guermantes)出版，并获得龚古尔文学奖，使普鲁斯特声名鹊起。1920-1922年间，他继续出版《索多姆与戈摩尔》(Sodome et Gomorrhe)和《女囚》(La Prisonnière)等部分。1922年11月18日，普鲁斯特因肺炎在巴黎去世，享年51岁。他去世时，《女囚》尚未完成，由他的弟弟罗伯特整理出版。普鲁斯特的巨著最终共七卷，成为20世纪最重要的文学作品之一，对现代主义文学产生了深远影响。
points.descriptionEn: In 1913, Du côté de chez Swann was finally published by Grasset, receiving praise from critic Léon Daudet. With the outbreak of World War I, Proust was exempted from military service due to his health and continued writing in his Paris apartment. In 1919, Le Côté de Guermantes was published and won the Prix Goncourt, bringing Proust considerable acclaim. Between 1920 and 1922, he continued to publish parts of his work, including Sodome et Gomorrhe and La Prisonnière. On November 18, 1922, Proust died of pneumonia in Paris at the age of 51. At his death, La Prisonnière was unfinished and was published posthumously by his brother Robert. Proust's monumental work eventually totaled seven volumes and became one of the most important literary works of the 20th century, exerting a profound influence on modernist literature.

appraisal.zh: 普鲁斯特被公认为20世纪最伟大的小说家之一，《追忆似水年华》开创意识流先河，深刻探索记忆、时间与意识的关系，其细腻心理描写与对微小细节的敏锐观察揭示了内心世界的复杂性，并影响了后世现代主义与后现代主义文学。不过也有研究者指出，他的作品冗长而自我中心，句子常长达数页，对贵族生活的描绘趋于理想化，内省有余而对外部社会关注不足，庞杂的叙事结构也使许多读者难以企及。
appraisal.en: Proust is widely regarded as one of the greatest novelists of the 20th century: In Search of Lost Time pioneered stream-of-consciousness literature, explored memory, time and consciousness, and through minute observation revealed the complexity of inner life, influencing later modernist and postmodernist writing. Yet some researchers note that his work is prolix and self-centered, with sentences spanning pages, that his portrayal of aristocratic life is idealized, and that its introspection leaves little attention to the external world, while its vast scale and complex structure deter many readers.

supporter.zh: 普鲁斯特被誉为20世纪最伟大的小说家之一，他的《追忆似水年华》开创了意识流文学的先河，深刻探索了记忆、时间和意识的关系。支持者认为他通过细腻的心理描写和对微小细节的敏锐观察，揭示了人类内心世界的复杂性。他的作品不仅是对法国贵族社会的描绘，更是对人类普遍经验的深刻洞察，影响了后来的现代主义和后现代主义文学。普鲁斯特对艺术、音乐和文学的深刻理解，以及他独特的叙事技巧，使他成为文学史上不可忽视的巨匠。
supporter.en: Proust is celebrated as one of the greatest novelists of the 20th century, whose In Search of Lost Time pioneered stream-of-consciousness literature and profoundly explored the relationships between memory, time, and consciousness. Supporters argue that through his细腻的心理描写 and keen observation of minute details, he revealed the complexity of the human inner world. His work not only depicts French aristocratic society but offers profound insights into universal human experiences, influencing later modernist and postmodernist literature. Proust's deep understanding of art, music, and literature, combined with his unique narrative techniques, establish him as an indispensable master in literary history.

critic.zh: 批评者指出普鲁斯特的作品过于冗长和自我中心，他的句子常常长达数页，缺乏简洁性。一些评论家认为他对贵族生活的描绘过于理想化，忽视了社会不平等的现实。此外，普鲁斯特的精英主义倾向和对传统价值观的依恋，使他难以完全接受现代社会的变革。他的作品也被批评为过于内省，缺乏对外部世界的关注。尽管《追忆似水年华》在文学史上具有重要地位，但其庞大规模和复杂的叙事结构也使其成为许多读者难以企及的作品。
critic.en: Critics point out that Proust's work is excessively long and self-centered, with sentences often spanning multiple pages lacking conciseness. Some argue that his depiction of aristocratic life is overly idealized, ignoring the realities of social inequality. Additionally, Proust's elitist tendencies and attachment to traditional values made him resistant to accepting modern societal changes. His work has also been criticized for being too introspective, lacking attention to the external world. Despite In Search of Lost Time's significance in literary history, its massive scale and complex narrative structure make it an intimidating work for many readers.

objective.zh: 在历史学界和流行文化中，普鲁斯特被定义为现代主义文学的奠基人之一，他的作品对20世纪文学产生了革命性影响。他的名字已成为深度思考和内省的代名词，'普鲁斯特式'成为描述复杂心理描写的术语。尽管他的作品阅读门槛高，但《追忆似水年华》被广泛认为是文学史上的巅峰之作，影响了包括弗吉尼亚·伍尔夫、詹姆斯·乔伊斯在内的众多作家。在当代文化中，普鲁斯特的思想被应用于心理学、哲学和认知科学领域，他的关于记忆和时间的理论持续引发学术讨论。普鲁斯特的形象也已成为知识分子和艺术家的文化符号，代表着对生活细节的极致关注和对内心世界的深入探索。
objective.en: In academic and popular culture, Proust is recognized as a foundational figure of modernist literature, whose work revolutionized 20th-century literature. His name has become synonymous with deep thinking and introspection, with 'Proustian' describing complex psychological descriptions. Despite its high reading threshold, In Search of Lost Time is widely regarded as a pinnacle of literary achievement, influencing numerous writers including Virginia Woolf and James Joyce. In contemporary culture, Proust's ideas are applied in psychology, philosophy, and cognitive science, with his theories on memory and time continuing to provoke academic discussion. Proust's image has also become a cultural symbol for intellectuals and artists, representing极致 attention to life's details and deep exploration of the inner world.

self.zh: 真正的发现之旅不在于寻找新的风景，而在于拥有新的眼睛。
self.en: The real voyage of discovery consists not in seeking new landscapes, but in having new eyes.
